api.title: LVN API
api.response_format: application/json for data endpoints; report downloads return file content.

authentication.usage: After login, append user_api_hash as a URL-encoded query parameter to subsequent authenticated requests. Login uses email and password.

Authentication.description: Login and obtain the user_api_hash required for all subsequent requests.

endpoint.description: Following a good response save 'user_api_hash' and use it for others requests. It may change in the future if user change a password, when system will return error.

optional.name: as
optional.description: Other user's to login as, email

Get Devices.description: Retrieve all vehicles assigned to the authenticated account. Supports optional filters.

optional.name: s
optional.description: Value to search in items properties

optional.name: limit
optional.description: Specifies amount of items per page

optional.name: page
optional.description: Specifies which page should be retrieved

optional.name: online
optional.description: Find items which status is `online` for the last specified amount of mintues

optional.name: offline
optional.description: Find items which status is `offline` for the last specified amount of mintues

Get Device Details.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific vehicle. Uses the same /get_devices endpoint with id or plate_number filter.

Latest Position / Live Updates.description: Returns only vehicles whose data has changed. Save the response time and pass it to the next request. A 5–10 second polling interval is suggested in the supplied LVN reference, not a documented server rate limit; confirm the permitted interval with the platform.

endpoint.description: Return only devices whose information has changed, all the response returns "time", the time needed to transmit the next request.

optional.name: time
optional.description: Filter items that were updated since provided UNIX timestamp

optional.name: filters[online]
optional.description: Find items which status is `online` for the last specified amount of mintues

optional.name: filters[offline]
optional.description: Find items which status is `offline` for the last specified amount of mintues

Device History.description: Retrieve historical movement and summary metrics for one device and a selected time period.

optional.name: snap_to_road
optional.description: Align GPS point to the nearest point on a road network

Get Reports.description: Retrieve saved report configurations. This does not download generated report files.

Get Report Types.description: Retrieve the report types available to the authenticated account.

Get Report Creation Data.description: Retrieve available devices, report types, output formats, geofences and stop options.

Generate Report.description: Generate a report for selected device IDs and dates. On documented success, status is 3 and url points to the generated file.

endpoint.description: If the request is successfully returned { 'status': 3 'url': ###}. "url" is link to generated report file

Create Saved Report.description: Save a report configuration. Confirm scheduling values and execution times with the platform before enabling scheduled email delivery.

Get Report Logs.description: Retrieve report logs and pagination metadata.

optional.name: search_phrase
optional.description: Value to be detected in properties

Download Scheduled Report.description: Download a sent scheduled report file using its report log ID, not the device ID or saved report configuration ID.

http_status_codes.meaning: Unauthorized — re-authenticate to get a new hash

notes: Login uses email and password. Subsequent authenticated requests require user_api_hash; pass lang where listed as required.
Store the vehicle id after the initial lookup to avoid repeated searches.
Use get_devices_latest for live updates — it reduces bandwidth and server load.
GPS coordinates (lat/lng) are in decimal format, compatible with Google Maps and GIS systems.
Get all device pages; get_devices returns groups containing items arrays. Store the device id, not IMEI or traccar_device_id, for report requests.
Merge live updates by device id. A device absent from a partial update is not necessarily deleted or offline.
Select report type IDs and formats from current API responses. Sample values are illustrative.
History uses from_date and to_date. Report bodies use date_from and date_to.
Resolve the generated report url against the server if it is relative. Download the referenced file rather than saving the JSON response as a PDF.
Confirm account timezone, measurement units, rate limits, date-range limits, scheduling behavior and download-link validity before production use.
This document follows the structure and server URL in LVN_API (1).json, with report and history definitions from stoplight1 (3).json. No live requests were executed.
